title: CanonicalEvent
description: Foundational, normalized event record for the WasmAgent evidence stream. Heterogeneous agent evidence (e.g. an open-agent-audit run) is normalized into one or more CanonicalEvents, which an adapter maps onto an aep-record. Field names deliberately mirror aep-record (trace_id, run_id, tool_name, state_changing, refs, signature) so the mapping is mechanical rather than lossy. For version-skew compatibility, this schema also accepts a valid AEP record.

schema_version.description: Version of the canonical-event schema this record conforms to.

event_id.description: Globally-unique identifier for this event within its trace.

event_type.description: Kind of event. 'action' maps to an aep-record action; 'decision' to a capability_decision; 'observation'/'error'/'lifecycle' to verifier_results or provenance.

timestamp_ms.description: UTC epoch milliseconds when the event occurred.

trace_id.description: Correlation id linking related events; maps to aep-record.trace_id.

run_id.description: Identifier of the run this event belongs to; maps to aep-record.run_id.

parent_event_id.description: Event id of the causally-preceding event, enabling causal-chain reconstruction; maps to aep-record.actions[].parent_action_id.

actor.description: The agent/tool/human/system that produced the event.

agent_version.description: Agent/runtime version, e.g. wasmagent-js@1.20.0; maps to aep-record.runtime_version / run_context.agent_version.

subject_id.description: Optional principal the event was performed on behalf of; maps to aep-record.subject_id / user_id.

tool_name.description: For action events, the tool invoked; maps to aep-record.actions[].tool_name.

state_changing.description: Whether the event mutates external state; maps to aep-record.actions[].state_changing and side_effect_class.

data.description: Type-specific payload for the event. Free-form; consumers narrow it by event_type. May carry tool arguments/results, decision rationale, verifier scores, etc.

refs.description: Input/output/evidence artifacts referenced by the event; maps to aep-record.input_refs / output_refs / evidence_refs.

digest.description: Content digest of the referenced artifact.

relation.description: How the artifact relates to the event.

source.description: Provenance of the event for adapter traceability.

adapter.description: Name/version of the adapter that produced this canonical event.

source_event_type.description: The native event type this was normalized from.

signature.description: Optional tamper-evident signature over the event content; maps to aep-record.signature.
